Title: Azure IoT Edge integration with Azure Monitor is now in public preview

Body.Content:
To simplify the monitoring and troubleshooting of your Azure IoT Edge devices, we’re launching the public preview of Azure IoT Edge monitoring solution, based on deep integration with Azure Monitor. Use it to:

  • Analyze the efficiency of your solution
  • Choose hardware to fit the performance demands on your devices
  • Create custom metrics and dashboards
  • Monitor locked down assets
  • Unify cloud and edge monitoring
  • Proactively identify issues with metric based alerts
  • Rapidly troubleshoot problems 

Check out this blog post or the IoT Show episode for a guided tour of the new capabilities.
